deep_analysis.executive_intro:
This FTSE screen is cautious overall: 131 names are on Hold and 58 on Avoid, versus 13 Strong Buy and 46 Buy in a 248-name universe. The five highest-ranked names all carry headline Strong Buy but were downgraded to Buy after FCF-basis and dividend-family overlays; none cleared the dividend factor family. Sector clustering is sharp at the top: three of five are Industrials (FGP.L, MEGP.L, MGNS.L), with HIK.L in Healthcare and IMB.L in Consumer Defensive. Cheapness, quality, GARP, and risk families pass broadly, but yield-driven models are often suppressed when filing, screen TTM, and company-adjusted FCF diverge. Treat headline yield and FCF yield as provisional until reconciled to filings—not Yahoo TTM alone.

**FGP.L (FirstGroup plc)** — Industrials, composite 86% (13/22 models), sector-relative 87%, conviction 59% (persistent, 19 weeks). Passes include Graham Enterprising, Earnings Yield, Low P/E + High Yield, Lynch PEG, Neff PEGY, Quality Value, Buffett Quality, Magic Formula, Piotroski F-Score, and Earnings Quality; failures include Graham Defensive (liquidity), FCF Yield and High Dividend (FCF basis unresolved), and Economic Moat. Key metrics: P/E 8.6, P/B 1.3, yield 4.3%, ROE 16.7%; filing D/E 19% vs Yahoo D/E 161% with £137.7m filing-adjusted net debt. FCF overlay: filing £362.6M, screen TTM £302.8M, company-adjusted £73.8M; statutory OCF−CapEx cover ~1.90× in structured fields (action note cites 9.32× on an alternate statutory FCF definition); adjusted EPS growth screen −5.9% vs filing +16.0%. Industrials concentration adds macro/regulatory correlation with peers MEGP.L and MGNS.L. **Verdict: watchlist** — attractive headline valuation and model breadth, but triple FCF definitions and failed dividend family warrant filing reconciliation before sizing.

**MEGP.L (ME Group International plc)** — Industrials, composite 83% (12/22), sector-relative 89%, conviction 58%. Passes Graham Enterprising, Earnings Yield, Low P/E + High Yield, Neff PEGY, Quality Value, Buffett Quality, Economic Moat, Magic Formula, and Financial Health; fails Lynch PEG (growth below floor), FCF Yield, High Dividend/Dividend Growth (FCF basis), Piotroski F-Score (6/9), and Earnings Quality (weak cash conversion). Metrics: P/E 8.0, P/B 2.3, yield 7.0%, ROE 28.2%, D/E 28%. FCF filing £25.2M vs screen TTM £15.6M; statutory dividend cover 0.84× vs management cash-generated 1.68×; interim-quality and cyclical-exposure overlays flag discretionary photobooth demand and thin net cover. **Verdict: watchlist** — cheap on earnings with quality passes, but 7.0% yield and sub-1.0× statutory cover plus cyclical overlay argue for interim filings before accumulate.

**MGNS.L (Morgan Sindall Group plc)** — Industrials, composite 80% (14/22), sector-relative 82%, conviction 55%. Strongest model count in the top five (Graham Enterprising, Earnings Yield, Low P/E + High Yield, Lynch PEG, Neff PEGY, Quality Value, Buffett Quality, Magic Formula, Piotroski F-Score, Earnings Quality, Financial Health); dividend yield models still suppressed on FCF basis. Metrics: P/E 11.1, P/B 2.6, yield 3.8%, ROE 26.1%, D/E 18%; filing FCF £170.7M vs screen TTM £141.5M; statutory OCF−CapEx dividend cover ~2.59×; earnings growth ~18.8% on screen baseline. Third Industrials name increases UK construction/cyclical cluster risk versus a diversified book. **Verdict: accumulate** — broadest pass set and filing-aligned cover above 2×, with sector cyclicality as the main offset to headline Strong Buy (adjusted to Buy).

**HIK.L (Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC)** — Healthcare, composite 76% (10/22), sector-relative 83%, conviction 54%; only top name with timing **accumulate** (RSI 55, price above 50- and 200-day MAs). Passes Graham Enterprising, Earnings Yield, Neff PEGY, Quality Value, Buffett Quality, Magic Formula, Financial Health; fails Low P/E + High Yield (P/E not below 12), FCF Yield (3.6% below 5%), Lynch PEG, Economic Moat (leverage), Dividend Growth, Piotroski (6/9), Earnings Quality. Metrics: P/E 12.2, P/B 1.9, yield 4.0%, ROE 15.4%, D/E 77%; filing FCF $119M vs screen TTM $14.4M; statutory cover 0.64× vs management 1.31×; screen earnings growth −4.7%. **Verdict: accumulate** — timing and quality/value passes support entry, contingent on confirming filing FCF supports the ordinary dividend (statutory cover below 1×).

**IMB.L (Imperial Brands PLC)** — Consumer Defensive, composite 77% (10/22), sector-relative 72%, conviction 51% (14 weeks at signal). Passes Earnings Yield, Low P/E + High Yield, Neff PEGY, Quality Value, Buffett Quality, Magic Formula, Earnings Quality; fails Graham Enterprising (P/B ≥ 3, leverage, negative earnings growth), Economic Moat, High Dividend/FCF Yield (FCF basis), Lynch PEG, Financial Health (debt, liquidity). Metrics: P/E 11.6, P/B 4.9, yield 6.7%, ROE 37.2%; filing FCF £3166M vs screen TTM £2502.4M (unverified); statutory cover ~2.03×; statutory earnings growth about −16.5% (Neff model). **Verdict: pass** — income and ROE screen well, but elevated P/B, shrinking earnings, moat/leverage failures, and tobacco/regulatory overhang sit poorly versus cleaner industrial picks.

- **FGP.L:** Public-transport contracting exposes revenue to concession resets, fuel/wage inflation, and political fare caps—not in the quant screen. Yahoo D/E 161% vs filing-adjusted net debt (£137.7m) can mis-state lease-adjusted leverage for covenant thinking. FCF policy uses company-adjusted £73.8M (canonical £113.5M) while filing cash flow shows £362.6M and screen TTM £302.8M—ordinary dividend sustainability depends on which definition matches continuing ops. Headline Strong Buy vs adjusted Buy and failed dividend family: do not treat 4.3% yield as filing-verified until cover is reconciled (structured statutory OCF−CapEx ~1.90× vs action-note “9.32×” on another statutory FCF basis). Adjusted EPS screen −5.9% vs filing +16.0% raises guidance/normalisation risk. Open question: any held-for-sale or discontinued segments—not flagged in JSON.

- **MEGP.L:** Discretionary photobooth/consumer exposure (cyclical-exposure overlay) with interim revenue decline; principal-at-risk model not captured in P/E. Statutory OCF−CapEx cover 0.84× vs management 1.68×—7.0% yield may look covered on adjusted cash but not on statutory net FCF. Failed dividend family and FCF Yield suppression despite filing £25.2M vs weaker screen TTM £15.6M. Earnings Quality fail (weak free-cash conversion). Open question: FX and geographic mix for reporting currency vs cash generation.

- **MGNS.L:** UK construction contracting: margin cyclicality, contract timing, and workload quality are not in the screen (no `uk_contractor_ch_backlog_margin_cyclical_detected` in payload—CH multi-year margin/backlog work is an external check). FCF filing £170.7M vs screen TTM £141.5M modest gap; dividend family still failed and High Dividend not top quartile despite 3.8% yield. Third top Industrials name—correlated downturn risk with FGP.L and MEGP.L. Statutory cover ~2.59× is supportive on filings but can compress in a downcycle.

- **HIK.L:** Generic/pharma pricing erosion, FDA/import reliance, and pipeline litigation are outside the model set. D/E 77% contributes to moat and balance-sheet model failures. Extreme filing vs screen TTM FCF gap ($119M vs $14.4M)—Yahoo TTM must not be used for dividend cover; statutory 0.64× vs management 1.31× implies dual cover risk. Negative screen earnings growth (−4.7%) with failed Dividend Growth. Adjusted Strong Buy → Buy on FCF overlay. Open question: M&A/integration cash drains not visible in headline metrics.

- **IMB.L:** Tobacco regulation, litigation, next-gen product transition, and ESG/index exclusion risk are qualitative. P/B 4.9 fails deep-value and Graham screens; negative earnings growth (−16.5% in Neff inputs) conflicts with income narrative. Screen TTM FCF marked unverified (£2502.4M vs filing £3166M)—6.7% yield and FCF-yield passes need filing bridge including buybacks/debt paydown. Statutory cover ~2.03× on OCF−CapEx but High Dividend suppressed for “FCF basis unresolved.” Leverage and liquidity failures on Financial Health. No carve-out/discontinued flag in JSON—open question whether consolidated FCF matches equity story post-portfolio changes.
deep_analysis.red_flags:
NAMES WORTH DEEPER RESEARCH

- **FGP.L** — Which FCF definition (filing £362.6M, screen TTM £302.8M, or company-adjusted £73.8M) reflects post-concession continuing cash flow, and does it cover the ordinary dividend on a statutory OCF−CapEx basis after lease and pension cash calls?

- **MEGP.L** — Do latest interim accounts show sustained photobooth revenue recovery and secured workload such that statutory OCF−CapEx cover stays above 1.0× through a discretionary spending downturn, or is the 7.0% yield reliant on management-adjusted cash definitions?

- **MGNS.L** — In Companies House “YYYY in numbers” (or equivalent filing narrative), how have adjusted operating margin and secured order book trend over multiple years versus the screen’s 18.8% earnings growth and 2.59× statutory dividend cover?

post_run_review.executive_summary: This run is cautious at the portfolio level (131 Hold, 58 Avoid vs 13 Strong Buy and 46 Buy in a 248-name universe) while buy-tier FTSE memos look healthy on paper: 20 sampled names are “strong” with accumulate verdicts and no thin_filing_tickers flagged. The deeper weakness is cash-flow and dividend conviction: every top-ranked name failed the dividend factor family after FCF-basis overlays, and deep analysis treats FGP.L and MEGP.L as watchlist despite headline model breadth. That gap between screen cheapness and filing-verified yield/FCF is systemic (ingest 173 vs prompt 55 in a 535-item backlog), not a one-off ticker miss. Euro_depth learning path shows medium-severity produce-layer drift—seven of nineteen sampled memos are thin or zero-body while ladder research executed only two passes and weekly_ops still shows $70.1 remaining—so green budget counters overstate research quality outside the FTSE buy book. Top FTSE picks are actionable for sizing only after FCF reconciliation (especially FGP.L, MEGP.L, HIK.L); MGNS.L is the relative exception with filing-aligned cover called out as accumulate.
post_run_review.persistent_weaknesses:
- **Ingest — RNS/Investegate bodies missing or wrapper URLs** (dominant backlog theme: ingest 173 / 535 total; 14 of 33 recent suggestions): indexed filings with `with_body: 0`, Google News redirects, and empty Ticker RNS API text recur in samples for AEP.L (31 with_body:0 cited in backlog), MEGP.L (52 indexed, 0 bodies in sample text), ITV.L, and generic “re-pull FY/interim annual report” patterns.

Ingest/sprint/maintenance workflows pass CRONJOB_API_KEY + WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_PAT. Soft-skips when secrets are missing. Do not attach these to FTSE weekday_paper at 08:25 UTC.

tasks.title: Clear engineering parked backlog when dispatch pauses
tasks.summary: When attention-parked count hits 8, engineering-queue emails and pauses dispatch plus parked-hunter-compile. Work oldest parks first via `ftse-engineering list-parked` (merge, cancel, or unpark). Queue auto-resumes when count drops below 7 and 30 minutes have elapsed since the last clearing action. Separate from project-traffic pause (stuck CI/conflict PRs).

tasks.title: Project traffic pause / unstick / EOD digest
tasks.summary: Weekday project-traffic (and ops-monitor) classifies stuck cursor/* PRs, pauses new engineering-agent dispatch, comments for CI/conflict fixes (appending pr_fix_occasions.json with failure reasons), may dispatch conflict-resolve for eng branches, stops Composer reburn / Cursor fail-loop automation waste (park burning tasks + pause), and writes a grounded EOD digest that lists today's eng merges (including independently verified ingest_narrow / scoring_narrow / compile_cap_drain auto-merges) plus common PR-fix failure reasons. Spot-check digest trajectory and the merges-today list when pause is active, auto-merges land, or a cohesion_bypass task still needed human merge because the actual diff stayed over the path cap.

tasks.title: Confirm buy-tier level cohort first fill
tasks.summary: ops-monitor fails when buy_tier_level acted with an empty book. Knobs stay frozen. Do not treat first-fill NAV as promotion truth (Sunday gates).

tasks.title: Read analysis review synthesis
tasks.summary: After analysis-review (~10:35 UTC), read analysis_review.md for backward metrics, proposed experiments, ingest trials, and the observe-only buy-tier chart-outcome mix (well timed / giveback / no terrible).

tasks.title: Phase C readiness assessment (observe-only)

tasks.title: Start Phase C freeze writer only when readiness is READY
tasks.summary: Before building or enabling the PIT autopsy freeze writer, confirm phase_c_readiness.json (or ftse-phase-c-readiness exit 0) is READY. Do not start Phase C on vibes or with --force-phase-b-done alone — that override does not invent rebalance history or feature coverage.

tasks.title: Watch shard epoch-0 and near-miss before forking AI
tasks.summary: Admitted markets (sp500, asx200) run a frozen buy-tier-level book plus equal-support. The AI-fork watch cut is buy-not-now (timing wait on buy-tier) and hold-near-buy (hold at or above 0.28). not-buy-tier and never-buy-tier are census/persistence inventories, not the sample. Do not spawn shard AI-judgment or decision-review --apply until epoch-0 and the tight groups have marks. Knob apply is the same gate as forking the AI track. FTSE remains the data lead.

tasks.title: Watch ingest capacity as more markets come on stream

Wait names stay on the observe-only near_miss_watch.json sample. Sunday prefers first-time memos and rememos the focus book only; admitted body-lag rememo and local-open marks are weekday jobs. tasks.title: Promote knob priors only when gates pass

tasks.summary: Keep 3% stress books as the defensive/churn lab. Before promoting knobs or calling primary 'beating the market', check ftse-trading-costs assess and/or fair-cost warm-start shadows. Promote only when fair excess beats ^FTSE and the fair rules control (or explicitly accept stress-only churn wins).

tasks.title: Spawn Suite B twins only for recommend experiments
tasks.summary: If experiment_assessment has recommend calibration/exclusion/experimental tracks, dry-run then optionally apply ftse-trading-costs spawn-fair-twins (max 2). Never auto-fork every shadow (N53). Zero recommend rows is a no-op.
